messages:
auditor_jen: Hi all — auditor asks: need 90 days of evidence that ties RBAC role updates to approver attestations, plus KMS key rotation history and a sample incident chain (alert -> ticket -> forensic snapshot). Prefer CSV/JSON exports and an S3 path. Deadline EOD Fri. Can someone confirm what we can produce?
samir-sec: we can provide that. For RBAC we'll correlate k8s audit + IAM change events + deploy logs. I'll grab CloudTrail + kube-audit samples and put an export together. quick Q: do auditors need full user emails or can we pseudonymize IDs?
leah-compliance: pseudonymized IDs are fine as long as we include a mapping manifest in a separate encrypted artifact. Also include a control mapping table with: control_id, event_type, evidence_path, sampling_notes.
samir-sec: noted. example CloudTrail lookup I plan to run:
```
AWS_REGION=us-west-2
aws cloudtrail lookup-events \
  --start-time 2025-02-01T00:00:00Z \
  --end-time 2025-05-01T00:00:00Z \
  --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=iam.amazonaws.com \
  --query 'Events[?contains(EventName, `PutRolePolicy`)]'
```
and for k8s audit events (elastic):
```
POST /_search
{
  "query": { "bool": { "must": [ { "match": { "verb": "create" } }, { "match": { "objectRef.resource": "rolebinding" } } ] } },
  "size": 1000
}
```
alice-infra: For KMS rotation history I can pull CloudTrail events for kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion/EnableKeyRotation/DisableKeyRotation and also `aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id <key-id>` for the static flag. Example CloudTrail filter:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01 --start-time 2025-02-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-05-01T00:00:00Z
```
carla-socops: I'll compile incident chain samples. We'll include 3 redacted cases: INC-2025-1234, INC-2025-1300, INC-2025-1401. For each we'll export alert JSON, associated Jira ticket, timeline notes, and a forensic snapshot pointer (s3 path). JQL I used:
```
project = IR AND created >= -90d AND labels in (compliance) ORDER BY created DESC
```
devops-bot: Export job started, bucket: s3://redwood-compliance-exports/1745129876/ ; files: rbacevents.csv, kms_history.json, incidents_export.tar.gz ; ETA ~12m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
auditor_jen: thanks — can you confirm the exported records contain these fields: event_time, principal_id (pseudonym ok), event_name, resource_arn, request_ip, request_parameters? Also need chain-of-custody manifest for the artifacts and the encryption key used for the export.
samir-sec: confirmed — exports will include event_time, principal_id (user_<hash>), event_name, resource_arn, request_ip, request_parameters. Manifest will be generated at s3://redwood-compliance-exports/1745129876/manifest.json (access via presigned URL). Encryption: SSE-KMS using alias/rdw-compliance-export-key. We'll record KMS key ARN and rotation history in the manifest.
leah-compliance: I'll author the control mapping CSV snippet and attach path:
```
control_id,event_type,evidence_path,sampling_method
ISO27001-A.9,role_change,s3://redwood-compliance-exports/1745129876/rbacevents.csv,random 30/90
SOC2-CC6,kms_rotation,s3://redwood-compliance-exports/1745129876/kms_history.json,full
SOC2-IR,incident_chain,s3://redwood-compliance-exports/1745129876/incidents_export.tar.gz,case samples
```
carla-socops: I've redacted PII and left mapping file encrypted at s3://redwood-compliance-exports/1745129876/pii_map.enc (KMS). Chain-of-custody note included in manifest. :lock:
auditor_jen: perfect, please send presigned URLs and a short README with redaction rules and how to verify KMS key rotation entries. we'll review once received. Appreciate quick turnaround :thumbsup:
samir-sec: will send presigned URLs and README in a separate secure message. tagging @leah-compliance to confirm mapping table is final.
leah-compliance: confirmed, sending final CSV to the secure share now. :white_check_mark:
